summary: Iteration 69 - Guardian Safe Zone CRUD Testing. Backend: 11/11 tests PASSED. Frontend: Geofencing page works in self-mode but FAILS to detect beneficiaryId query param for guardian mode due to Expo Router useLocalSearchParams() limitation on web.

integration_issues.issue: useLocalSearchParams() does not detect ?beneficiaryId= query param when navigating directly to URL on web. Page shows 'Zones de securite' (self-mode) instead of 'Safe zones beneficiaire' (guardian mode)
integration_issues.root_cause: Known Expo Router issue - useLocalSearchParams() fails to read query params on direct URL navigation on web
integration_issues.potential_fix: Use useGlobalSearchParams() or manually parse window.location.search on Platform.OS === 'web'
